---
name: Vehicle catalog correction
about: Report a missing, inaccurate, or outdated vehicle model in the built-in catalog
title: '[CATALOG] '
labels: catalog
assignees: ''
---

### Vehicle Information
- **Manufacturer / Make**: [e.g. Mazda]
- **Model Name**: [e.g. CX-30]
- **Model Years**: [e.g. 2020-2024]
- **Known WMI Prefix** (first 3 characters of VIN, optional): [e.g. 3MV, JM1]

### Correction Details
- **Type**: [Missing Model / Incorrect Year Range / Name Typo / Duplicate]
- **Current Behavior**: What currently displays in the catalog search or dropdown.
- **Proposed Correction**: What the entry should be.

### Reference / Verification Source
Please provide a reference (e.g. official manufacturer press release, EPA certificate, or vehicle registration authority guide) confirming this model and year range.
